reason.title: Where a good digital product makes a difference
reason.subtitle: A well-planned website shortens the sales conversation. A well-built system removes spreadsheets, repetitive tasks and scattered information from the workflow.
reason.card1Text: Organize services, work and company information so the right customer quickly understands what you offer.
reason.card2Text: Answer recurring questions and direct quote requests even outside business hours.
reason.card3Text: Bring data, records and operational steps into a system designed around how the team works.
reason.card4Text: Automate repetitive tasks and give operations a more organized foundation for increased volume.

services.title: From the public website to internal operations
services.card1Title: Websites built to present and sell
services.card1Desc: Corporate websites and landing pages with clear content hierarchy, fast loading, technical SEO and direct paths to contact.
services.card2Desc: Internal tools, dashboards and AI automation that centralize data, reduce manual tasks and support decisions.
services.card3Desc: Catalog, cart, checkout, payments and logistics integrations brought together in a sales operation that is easy to manage.
services.card4Desc: We connect payments, CRM, ERP and other services to keep data synchronized and avoid duplicate work.
services.card5Desc: We configure environments, domains, automated deployment, monitoring and backups to keep your application available.
services.card6Desc: We build triggers, notifications and workflows that reduce repetitive tasks for your team.
services.card7Desc: We organize content and flows into clear interfaces that are validated before development.

process.title: A clear process, from scope to launch
process.step1Text: We map the context, users, priorities and constraints to establish a scope everyone understands.
process.step2Text: We organize content and flows, design the screens and validate the prototype before moving into code.
process.step3Text: We build the application, integrate the required services and review each delivery in short cycles.
process.step4Text: We test the main flows, configure the domain and infrastructure and deliver the product ready for use.

servicesPage.title: What we can
servicesPage.subtitle: We handle planning, interface design, development and launch. Every project starts with the problem that needs solving, not a preset list of technologies.
servicesPage.techStackDesc: We choose tools according to the product, the team that will maintain it and the integrations it requires.
servicesPage.service1Desc: We organize content, the value proposition and contact paths into pages that are fast, accessible and easy to update.
servicesPage.service1Alt: SEO optimization illustration representing professional website creation
servicesPage.service2Alt: Dashboard panel illustration representing custom-built systems
servicesPage.service3Alt: API connections illustration representing integration between systems
servicesPage.service4Alt: Rocket illustration representing cloud application deployment
servicesPage.service5Alt: Connected pieces illustration representing integration between platforms
servicesPage.service2Desc: We build tools that centralize records, permissions, tasks and indicators, using AI where it meaningfully improves the team's workflow.
servicesPage.service3Desc: We structure authentication, data and business rules to connect your applications and third-party services with clear documentation.
servicesPage.service4Desc: We prepare environments, domain, certificates, automated deployment and backup routines to put the application into production predictably.
servicesPage.service5Desc: We connect payments, CRM, ERP, messaging and other platforms to avoid duplicate data entry and keep information synchronized.
servicesPage.service6Desc: We configure triggers, approvals, notifications and data transfers to reduce manual steps in recurring tasks.

projects.rafahelena: The website organizes architect Rafaela Helena's projects, services and contact information in a visual presentation that keeps the portfolio front and center.
projects.rafahelenaShort: Architecture portfolio with featured projects, organized services and direct contact.
projects.sdl: SDL Consultoria's website presents its occupational safety, environmental and training services and directs interested companies to the team.
projects.sdlShort: Website that explains the consultancy's practice areas and directs new inquiries.
projects.lovegoods: The Lovegoods online store organizes creative gifts and collectibles in a catalog designed for discovery, product details and online purchasing.
projects.lovegoodsShort: Online store with a gift and collectibles catalog, product pages and checkout.
projects.cloock: Cloock brings schedules, services, blocks and bookings into one scheduling platform for appointment-based businesses.
projects.cloockShort: Platform for configuring services, managing schedules and receiving online bookings.
projects.guilherme: Guilherme Schulze's website organizes photography and video work into a visual portfolio, with space to present projects and receive inquiries.
projects.guilhermeShort: Photography and video portfolio organized by project, with direct contact.
projects.auros: For Auros, we connected an internal property management system to a public website with search, listings and detailed property pages.
projects.aurosShort: Internal property management connected to the agency's public website and listings.
projects.fidliz: Fidliz replaces physical loyalty cards: customers check and collect points on their phones while each business manages its program through the platform.
projects.minhareserva: Minha Reserva lets teachers check schedules and available equipment and book classrooms in one system.
projects.minhaprova: Minha Prova lets teams assemble assessments, apply personalized questions and calculate grades in real time.
projects.apjesc: The APJESC project combines the association's public portal with an internal area for managing courses, members and content.
projects.magaventures: The Magaventures system brings revenue and portfolio startup indicators into monitoring dashboards for the management team.
projects.patrono: Patrono's website, built for UESC's junior law enterprise, organizes practice areas, services and contact channels for prospective clients.
projects.patronoShort: Website for UESC's junior law enterprise, with organized services and contact channels.
projects.tbmotors: We built the website for TB Motors, a premium pre-owned vehicle dealership. The platform showcases the full inventory of cars and motorcycles with detailed listings, search filters and direct WhatsApp contact.
projects.tbmotorsShort: Website for a premium pre-owned vehicle dealership, featuring a vehicle showcase, search filters and direct WhatsApp contact.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.t1Content: My architecture website turned out excellent! Exactly the way I wanted it, highly recommend!!
testimonials.t2Content: I had my professional website built with Code Labz and it turned out excellent! The design is very beautiful, modern and the navigation is super fluid. I was very satisfied with the result and highly recommend it!
testimonials.t3Content: Hiring Code Labz was essential. They developed a complete solution for us: a modern website for clients and a robust system for our property management. I strongly recommend them for quality and competence.
testimonials.t4Content: Code Labz did an excellent job on our Landing Page. The website turned out professional, objective and perfectly conveyed the seriousness of our consulting firm. I recommend them for their speed and quality.
testimonials.t5Content: Excellent work from Code Labz. They developed a complete portal and an internal system that greatly facilitated the administration and control of our members. I recommend!
testimonials.t6Content: Incredible work! We reached the final version of the website in less than 2 weeks! Vinicius is super attentive and dedicated, always available to answer questions and make any changes! The website turned out exactly the way I always dreamed for the company, I highly recommend it!
testimonials.t7Content: A serious and committed company — service and problem resolution are immediate.
